note: Vocabulary for DeckRoleClassifier. `keywords` match Scryfall's structured card keywords (case-insensitive). `text` are oracle-text cues: a plain string is a substring match; a string with '|' requires ALL parts present (AND). `excludeLands` drops lands from the role (they are the mana base, not ramp). `summary` is the beginner-facing explainer shown when a role chip is tapped. Add a role object or extend a list to tune — no code change.

roles.label: Ramp
roles.summary: Cards that produce extra mana so you can cast bigger spells sooner — mana rocks, mana dorks, and land fetchers. Decks that want to ramp usually run around ten or more pieces.

roles.label: Card Draw
roles.summary: Cards that refill your hand so you keep finding gas instead of running empty. Steady card draw is one of the biggest things separating consistent decks from streaky ones.

roles.label: Removal
roles.summary: Interaction that deals with the opponent's threats — destroying, exiling, countering, bouncing, or shrinking them. Removal is how you stop them from simply executing their own plan.

roles.label: Tutor
roles.summary: Cards that search your library for a specific card, letting you find your best answer or combo piece on demand. Tutors make a deck more consistent but thin your library.
